title: Clause: Carpet Area Definition
text: The Apartment A-1204 in Capital Greens Heights comprises a net RERA carpet area of 1,020 sq.ft (94.76 sq.m) and an undivided share in land, corresponding to a super built-up area of 1,450 sq.ft (134.7 sq.m). Common areas are excluded from carpet area.

title: Clause: Permissible Measurement Tolerance
text: Under The Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act, 2016, if the final verified carpet area deviates by more than 3% from 1,020 sq.ft (94.76 sq.m), the total consideration shall be proportionately refunded or charged at the original booking rate.

title: Clause: Super Built-Up Proportion
text: The Allottee acquires proportionate interest in common areas corresponding to carpet area 1,020 sq.ft (94.76 sq.m) within 1,450 sq.ft (134.7 sq.m) across the residential tower layout in New Delhi.

title: Clause: Measurement Survey and Plan Verification
text: Prior to registration of title, the Allottee shall have liberty to inspect the internal dimensions of Apartment A-1204 against architectural drawings deposited with planning authorities in New Delhi. Final consideration shall adhere strictly to verified carpet area.

title: Clause: Termination for Default
text: If the Allottee commits an unrectified payment breach after 30 days notice, the Promoter may terminate this agreement and forfeit the earnest money deposit of Rs. 14,50,000/- (Rupees Fourteen Lakhs Fifty Thousand only) under The Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act, 2016.

title: Clause: Buyer Cancellation Rights

title: Clause: Voluntary Surrender Deduction

title: Clause: Forfeiture Benchmark and Account Settlement

title: Clause: Minor Plan Adjustments
text: The Promoter reserves the right to make minor architectural adjustments or alterations in layout plans of Capital Greens Heights as mandated by statutory sanctioning authorities in New Delhi, without reducing carpet area.

title: Clause: Major Revision Consent
text: In compliance with Section 14 of The Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act, 2016, no major structural alterations or addition to sanctioned building plans of Capital Greens Heights shall be executed without the prior written consent of at least two-thirds of allottees.

title: Clause: Specification Substitution
text: The Promoter may substitute specified fittings, vitrified tiles, or sanitary brands with equivalent high-grade materials if original materials become commercially unavailable in New Delhi.

title: Clause: Elevation and Common Zone Variations
text: External elevation changes, facade paint alterations, or landscaping realignment necessitated by civil regulations in New Delhi may be executed by Promoter without individual purchaser sanction.

title: Clause: Five Year Structural Warranty
text: Under Section 14(3) of The Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act, 2016, the Promoter shall rectify any structural defect, workmanship defect, or quality defect in Capital Greens Heights notified within 5 years from possession date without cost.

title: Clause: Defect Rectification Timeline
text: Upon receiving written notice of structural fissures, water seepage, or mechanical failure in Apartment A-1204, the Promoter in New Delhi shall inspect and rectify the defect within 30 days.

title: Clause: Exclusions from Defect Warranty
text: The defect liability warranty for Capital Greens Heights does not cover normal wear and tear, superficial cosmetic settling, or damages caused by unauthorized structural alterations executed by the Allottee.

title: Clause: Workmanship Warranty and Sub-Contractor Guarantee
text: The structural engineer and project architect shall issue a structural stability certificate for Capital Greens Heights. The Promoter warrants electrical conduits and sanitary plumbing against leakage for 5 years.

title: Clause: Force Majeure Circumstances
text: Neither party shall be held liable for delay in performance of obligations regarding Capital Greens Heights if prevented by Force Majeure, including war, flood, earthquake, epidemic, statutory ban, or labor strike in New Delhi.

title: Clause: Force Majeure Notice
text: The Promoter shall give written notice to the Allottee within 14 days of the start of any Force Majeure event. The construction schedule under The Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act, 2016 shall be extended accordingly.

title: Clause: Cessation of Force Majeure
text: Upon cessation of the uncontrollable delay or revocation of government shutdown orders in New Delhi, the Promoter shall promptly resume normal construction activities on Capital Greens Heights.

title: Clause: Extension of Delivery Deadlines
text: Where construction progress is suspended due to judicial restraining orders or statutory moratoriums affecting New Delhi, the stipulated handover date of 31st December 2026 shall be extended pro-rata.

title: Clause: Arbitration Agreement
text: Any dispute arising out of this agreement for Apartment A-1204 in Capital Greens Heights shall be settled by arbitration in accordance with the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996, with seat and venue at New Delhi.

title: Clause: Territorial Jurisdiction
text: Subject to the statutory jurisdiction of the Real Estate Regulatory Authority under The Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act, 2016, the Courts of New Delhi shall have exclusive territorial jurisdiction over any legal proceeding.

title: Clause: Amicable Conciliation
text: Prior to formal dispute resolution or arbitration, the parties shall make an earnest attempt to conciliate any dispute regarding Capital Greens Heights through informal discussions within 30 days.

title: Clause: Exclusive Tribunal Authority
text: Complaints regarding unfair practices or contravention of The Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act, 2016 shall be instituted before the Real Estate Regulatory Authority having appellate bench in New Delhi.

title: Clause: Statutory Project Registration
text: The Promoter covenants that Capital Greens Heights has been registered under The Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act, 2016 with registration number DLRERA2021P0042, and all quarterly compliance disclosures are updated on the web portal.

title: Clause: Sanctioned Building Approvals
text: The Promoter represents that it holds valid commencement certificates, approved building plans, and environmental NOCs from the municipal corporation of New Delhi for Capital Greens Heights.

title: Clause: Compliance with Municipal Bye-laws
text: Construction of Capital Greens Heights shall strictly conform to prevailing building regulations, sanctioned FSI norms, and fire safety codes issued by competent authorities in New Delhi.

title: Clause: Environmental Clearances and Fire Safety NOC
text: The Promoter warrants that the state pollution control board and municipal fire service have accorded unconditional approvals for construction of Capital Greens Heights in New Delhi.

title: Clause: Common Area Maintenance Fees
text: The Allottee of Apartment A-1204 agrees to pay regular common area maintenance fees at Rs. 4.50 per sq.ft monthly for lighting, lift operation, security, and common amenities in Capital Greens Heights.

title: Clause: Sinking Fund and Advance Deposit
text: At the time of taking possession in New Delhi, the Allottee shall pay an advance maintenance deposit for 12 months and a sinking fund contribution to be transferred to the resident association.

title: Clause: Handover to Resident Welfare Association
text: Upon issuance of the occupancy certificate, the Promoter shall initiate steps to form the Society or Apex Body of Allottees and handover maintenance management of Capital Greens Heights.

title: Clause: Electricity Substation and Meter Infrastructure Levies
text: Individual electrical connection charges, transformer installation levies, and water meter deposits shall be paid directly by the Allottee to municipal supply undertakings in New Delhi.

title: Clause: Service of Legal Notices
text: All legal notices required to be served under this agreement shall be in writing and sent to the registered address in New Delhi by registered post with acknowledgment due or verified email.

title: Clause: Severability of Terms
text: If any covenant in this agreement for Capital Greens Heights is held to be invalid or contrary to The Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act, 2016, the remaining terms, conditions, and covenants shall remain binding and in full force.

title: Clause: Entire Agreement and Supersession
text: This Agreement represents the entire covenant between the parties regarding Apartment A-1204 in Capital Greens Heights and supersedes all prior brochures, marketing materials, and informal representations.

title: Clause: Successors and Legal Heirs
text: All provisions and obligations herein contained shall be binding upon the legal heirs, executors, administrators, and permitted assigns of the respective parties.

text: The Promoter covenants that Aravalli Horizon Apartments has been registered under National Capital Territory of Delhi Real Estate Rules, 2016 with registration number DLRERA2019P0018, and all quarterly compliance disclosures are updated on the web portal.

title: Clause: Sanctioned Building Approvals
text: The Promoter represents that it holds valid commencement certificates, approved building plans, and environmental NOCs from the municipal corporation of New Delhi for Aravalli Horizon Apartments.

title: Clause: Compliance with Municipal Bye-laws
text: Construction of Aravalli Horizon Apartments shall strictly conform to prevailing building regulations, sanctioned FSI norms, and fire safety codes issued by competent authorities in New Delhi.

title: Clause: Environmental Clearances and Fire Safety NOC
text: The Promoter warrants that the state pollution control board and municipal fire service have accorded unconditional approvals for construction of Aravalli Horizon Apartments in New Delhi.

title: Clause: Common Area Maintenance Fees
text: The Allottee of Apartment Wing E - Penthouse 1801 agrees to pay regular common area maintenance fees at Rs. 6.50 per sq.ft monthly for lighting, lift operation, security, and common amenities in Aravalli Horizon Apartments.

title: Clause: Handover to Resident Welfare Association
text: Upon issuance of the occupancy certificate, the Promoter shall initiate steps to form the Society or Apex Body of Allottees and handover maintenance management of Aravalli Horizon Apartments.

title: Clause: Severability of Terms
text: If any covenant in this agreement for Aravalli Horizon Apartments is held to be invalid or contrary to National Capital Territory of Delhi Real Estate Rules, 2016, the remaining terms, conditions, and covenants shall remain binding and in full force.

title: Clause: Entire Agreement and Supersession
text: This Agreement represents the entire covenant between the parties regarding Apartment Wing E - Penthouse 1801 in Aravalli Horizon Apartments and supersedes all prior brochures, marketing materials, and informal representations.
